task1.title: Letter to a Friend Inviting to a Wedding
task1.prompt: You are planning to get married and would like to invite a close friend to your wedding ceremony. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter, you should: 1. Explain the details of the wedding ceremony. 2. Share why it is important for you to have them there. 3. Mention any plans for the celebration afterwards. Make sure to write at least 150 words.

task2.title: The Role of Technology in Education
task2.prompt: Some people believe that technology has made education more accessible and effective. Others argue that it has made students overly reliant on electronic devices and distracted from traditional learning methods. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Support your argument with relevant examples and details. Write at least 250 words.
